name: Billy Doe Meats
verdict: Billy Doe Meats delivered a 5.28 ROAS on $1,485.72 in Meta spend over 28 days, generating 39 purchases and $7,838.50 in revenue, but the biggest concern is a 27.27% drop in purchases week-over-week, likely tied to the 9.99% spend pullback and audience fatigue on the top campaign "BWS - Sales - Muslims" ($837.62 spend). GBP engagement also fell sharply at -58.97% week-over-week, suggesting reduced local visibility that may be compounding the purchase decline.

performance.verdict: ROAS holding but purchase volume collapsing; GBP dark is the hidden accelerant.

findings.text: Purchases collapsed to 2 in last 3 days (Sep 15–17) vs 6 in prior 3 (Sep 12–14), on nearly identical ~$55/day spend — revenue per dollar deteriorating at flat cost.
SOW: Funnel test + UTM live (Aug 31), Pre-launch gate (Aug 31), Platform ownership audit (Aug 31), and Aug 14 live-cooking event are all overdue with no completion recorded.
GBP actions dropped to 0 on Sep 16–17 (from 25–35/day in Aug) — 58.97% weekly decline; local discovery feeding paid is now dark.
Top campaign 'BWS - Sales - Muslims' consumed $837.62 (56% of 28-day spend) with purchase volume now in 3-day freefall — pattern matches frequency burnout documented in June retargeting failure.
GA4 sessions fell to 227 on Sep 17, lowest single day in 28-day window; IG reach holding ~600–650 — paid traffic drop is not organic-side, points to Meta delivery tightening.

suggestions.text: Inject new creative into 'BWS - Sales - Muslims' to counter frequency burnout; use approved real-footage assets from Jul 21 Haney delivery.
suggestions.monday_update: Purchases dropped to 2 over Sep 15–17 on $183 spend while the prior 3 days delivered 6 purchases on similar spend — the 'BWS - Sales - Muslims' campaign ($837.62 / 56% of budget) shows the same frequency-burnout signature as the June retargeting failure. Introduce at least 2 new ad creatives using the real facility footage delivered by Haney on Jul 21; do not duplicate existing copy angles. Success check: purchases recover to ≥4 over any rolling 3-day window within 7 days of launch (by Sep 25).

suggestions.text: Diagnose GBP dark condition — 0 actions Sep 16–17 after 25–47/day in Aug; restore local signals before next paid cycle.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit zero on Sep 16 and 17 after averaging 25–47/day through most of August and early September. This is confirmed, not a gradual slide — check for a suspended profile, missing hours update, or a Google-side indexing issue. Success check: GBP actions return to ≥20/day within 3 days of the fix being applied; escalate to Nacer (Ops) immediately if profile suspension is confirmed.

suggestions.text: Watch overall ROAS and daily purchases through Sep 21 before any budget move; do not scale on a 1.21% ROAS delta with purchase volume falling.
suggestions.monday_update: The 7-day ROAS delta is only +1.21% and purchases are in a confirmed 3-day decline (2 purchases, Sep 15–17). The 28-day ROAS of 5.28x is healthy but is being averaged over sporadic high-value days (e.g. Sep 9: $1,727 revenue) that mask the current downtrend. Do not raise daily budget from the current ~$53/day until purchases recover to ≥4 over a 3-day window. Re-check Sep 21.
